new_causal_evidence: The recorded command names a file that no longer exists. The measurement instrument was reimplemented in Rust and the legacy implementation it invoked was deleted, so the receipt on QOMM-MARKET-THICKNESS-SMOKE-002 describes a run of a different instrument than the one this repository now contains. The Rust binary was compared against that legacy implementation value by value while both existed --- 546 non-timing values identical, 0 different --- so this is a re-run of the same experiment on a rebuilt instrument, not a new hypothesis. Nothing about the market, the seeds, the population or the rules has changed.
bottleneck: The current result does not show whether the privacy and utility findings survive thin maker sets and large requested sizes.
hypothesis: With the same market, requests and probes, hiding per-maker request delivery reduces recovery of an individual maker's inventory while leaving execution results unchanged inside each market cell.
prediction: Mean individual-maker inventory correlation will be at least 30 percent lower under QOMM than plain RFQ.
likely_failure: Large requests in four-maker markets lose fill rate or quote continuation before the privacy difference is informative.
single_change: Sweep maker count and forced order-size regime while keeping the paired plain/QOMM stream identical and disclosure disabled.
evaluation_population: 3 paired synthetic seeds, 6000 steps, maker counts 4/8/16, and small/medium/large requested-size regimes
rejection_rule: Reject the point prediction if the mean relative reduction is below 30 percent; label any three-seed result smoke_only regardless of direction.
promotion_rule: This run cannot promote a design. It may only select a confirmation hypothesis.
